_about: Bridge-deck elevation control points, keyed by crossing ID (XS-*) or deck ID (BRG-*). Heights are in the SIMULATOR height reference (see data/vertical_reference.json) at the road surface centreline. NEVER derive these from terrain/water heights under the deck. Acceptable sources, best first: (1) ASPRS class 17 'bridge deck' lidar returns (e.g. NYC 2017 topobathymetric lidar, USGS 3DEP point clouds), median of returns within 1 m of the centreline; (2) published engineering drawings / clearance data; (3) first-return DSM sampled on the centreline with outlier rejection. Record the source per point. Major crossings require >= 2 controls; more for long or cambered spans (every ~100 m and at towers). Controls carry z_native_m (authoritative, in native_datum) and z_sim_m (derived at extraction time; builds re-derive it from z_native_m with the current data/vertical_reference.json). Keys are deck IDs (BRG-*) from the inventory; a crossing ID (XS-*) key applies to all its decks.
